February 2027 · Early Interest List Open

200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training.

A small-group, Yoga Alliance-certified 200-hour TTC, hosted by Geeta Payal at JuneGiri Farms. Launching February 2027. Batches of 14 only.

Join the interest list →
Home / Retreats / 200-hr TTC
Coming February 2027

No 200 students in a hall. No assembly-line certificates. Just 14 students per batch, taught by Geeta Payal (10+ years teaching, 200-hr RYT) over 24 days at the edge of Rajaji forest. Yoga Alliance certification on completion.

What you'll learn

Curriculum at a glance.

🧘

Asana technique

Hatha and Vinyasa. Alignment, sequencing, modifications.

💨

Pranayama & meditation

Breathwork, mantra, dhyana. Daily practice + theory.

📚

Philosophy

Patanjali's Yoga Sutras. Bhagavad Gita basics. History.

🧠

Anatomy

Functional anatomy for yoga teachers. Injury awareness.

🎤

Teaching methodology

How to cue, sequence, hold space, handle a real class.

📜

Practicum

You'll teach 12 supervised classes before graduation.
